tasks.title: Implement Input Validation Module
tasks.description: Create a validation module that validates all inputs before they are sent to the Notion API. This includes validating task titles (non-empty strings, length limits), status values (against allowed list), notes (length limits), and page IDs (format validation).
acceptance_criteria: Validation function for task titles (1-2000 chars)
Validation function for Notion page IDs (UUID format)
All validators return clear error messages

tasks.title: Implement Error Handling Utilities
tasks.description: Create comprehensive error handling utilities including custom error classes, retry logic with exponential backoff, and error categorization (network, API, validation, authentication). This provides a foundation for robust error management.
acceptance_criteria: Custom error classes for different error types
Retry logic with configurable attempts and backoff

tasks.title: Implement Logging System
tasks.description: Create a structured logging system that logs all operations, errors, and API interactions with appropriate log levels (debug, info, warn, error). Should support different output formats and destinations.
acceptance_criteria: Timestamp and context in all logs

tasks.title: Enhance Create Task Function
tasks.description: Refactor the existing createTask function to use the new validation, error handling, and logging modules. Add support for priority levels and due dates. Improve assignee handling.

tasks.title: Enhance Update Task Function
tasks.description: Refactor the existing updateTask function to use validation, error handling, and logging. Support partial updates (only update provided fields) and add support for updating priority and due dates.

tasks.title: Implement Task Retrieval Function
tasks.description: Create a new function to retrieve a single task by its page ID. Should return formatted task data including all properties. Integrate with validation, error handling, and logging.

tasks.title: Implement Task Listing Function
tasks.description: Create a function to list all tasks from the Notion database with optional filtering by status, priority, assignee, and date ranges. Should support pagination for large datasets.
acceptance_criteria: Returns array of formatted task objects

tasks.title: Implement Task Search Function
tasks.description: Create a function to search tasks by title or content using Notion's query API. Should support partial matches and return ranked results.

tasks.title: Implement Task Deletion Function
tasks.description: Create a function to delete (archive) tasks by page ID. In Notion, this typically means moving to trash or archiving the page.

tasks.title: Implement Bulk Operations Module
tasks.description: Create functions for bulk operations including bulkCreateTasks, bulkUpdateTasks, and bulkDeleteTasks. Should handle rate limiting and provide progress feedback.

tasks.title: Create Comprehensive Test Suite
tasks.description: Develop unit tests for all functions using a testing framework (Jest or Mocha). Include mocks for Notion API calls. Test both success and failure scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: Test suite using Jest or Mocha

tasks.title: Create Documentation and Examples
tasks.description: Write comprehensive documentation including API reference, setup instructions, usage examples, and troubleshooting guide. Update README with complete project information.
acceptance_criteria: Updated README.md with full project overview
Inline JSDoc comments for all functions

parallel_execution_groups.note: These can be developed in parallel as they have no dependencies
Must complete Foundation first, can be parallelized
Requires Core Enhancements and some New Features
Final phase after all implementation tasks
